description:
MECHANICAL ENGINEERING - DEVELOPER

About Us:
Shield AI is a leading defense technology company dedicated to protecting service members and civilians through innovative, intelligent systems. Our technology portfolio includes advanced autonomy software, cutting-edge aircraft, and simulation platforms, supporting worldwide operations from our international offices.

 

Job Overview:
We are seeking a skilled Mechanical Engineering - Developer to join our dynamic team. You will play a key role in designing, developing, and integrating mechanical systems for next-generation aerospace and defense products. This is an opportunity to work with multidisciplinary teams, contribute to the entire product lifecycle, and help drive the future of intelligent defense systems.

 

Key Responsibilities:

 - Design and develop mechanical components and systems, from concept through production, for advanced defense and aerospace platforms.

 - Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams (software, electrical, manufacturing) to integrate mechanical solutions into complex products.

 - Conduct analyses to ensure optimal system performance and reliability in challenging environments.

 - Utilize industry-standard simulation tools and development processes for modeling, prototyping, and testing.

 - Support make-versus-buy decisions, vendor engagement, qualification, and integration of third-party components as needed.

 - Troubleshoot and resolve complex mechanical and system-level challenges during design, testing, and production phases.

 - Prepare technical documentation, conduct design reviews, and contribute to continuous process improvement.

 

Qualifications:

 - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - Proven experience in mechanical design and product development, preferably for aerospace, defense, automotive, or similarly regulated industries.

 - Familiarity with CAD software, simulation tools, and engineering analysis methods.

 - Experience working with multidisciplinary teams to integrate mechanical and electronic systems.

 - Strong communication and collaboration skills.

 - Advanced knowledge of manufacturing methods, materials selection, and testing protocols is a plus.

 

Preferred Qualifications:

 - Experience with high-performance, mission-critical mechanical systems in aerospace, automotive, or similar environments.

 - Background in system integration, including mechanical, electrical, and software components.

 - Familiarity with regulatory standards (such as MIL-STD, AS9100, or similar).

 

What We Offer:

 - Competitive salary, bonus, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

 - Opportunity to work on state-of-the-art products in a mission-driven environment.

 - Collaborative and innovative company culture.

 - Professional development and career growth opportunities.

 

Shield AI is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.
